part: DS-V4.1 HBM accelerator KV/index paths at 1M (position 1,048,575)
design: W19 TP-96 program (results/rtl/w19_hbm_tp96_program_oreduce.json): keys/CKV sharded by position over 96 dies, 4 HBM3E stacks a die
rtl_record_source_note: bench + runner uncommitted at run time (source_dirty true); sha256 pins in the record
peak_note: 1.0 TB/s a stack = 32 PCs x 32 B per CK/2 cycle (1.024 ns); 4.0 TB/s a die; the 52ce3e9c1 stream PC is measured, not modelled
minimum_component: one stack (32 PCs) simulated, die = 4 identical stacks composed analytically
exactness: every consumed sector compared with its stored pattern (all cases PASS, 0 DRAM timing violations); negative controls: corrupt sector FAIL, tRCD+1 ns FAIL

paths.path: index-key scan, L20-type layers (20,24,28,32,36; source L20 keys)

as_built.vehicle: R5a stream PC, 32-deep landing, no notice

refactor.vehicle: 64-deep landing (credits 64) + static-schedule notice + key RDs 30 ns before the query

consumer_limit.note: W19 ladder die scorer NK 4 keys/cycle (1 a stack): consumer-bound

paths.limiter_as_built: landing crossing 32 entries < ~40-cycle credit round trip, plus REFpb on a needed bank (no notice)
paths.limiter_refactor: HBM peak (1 RD a PC a cycle); exposed 10 ns

paths.path: index-key scan, L2-type layers (2,8,14; own keys)
paths.limiter_refactor: HBM peak while streaming (steady >=95.8%); 91-sector stream: fixed 10 ns exposure + credit-capped prefetch leaves worst end-to-end 88.8%

paths.path: selected compressed-KV row gather (8 layers, after the 96x512 merge)

refactor.vehicle: CKV rows placed in bank sets 0..2 + static-schedule notice over the gather window

paths.limiter: latency (1.5 KB/die: one ACT+RD per PC); bandwidth fraction not meaningful (<1%); as built a REFpb on the row bank adds up to 200 ns

paths.path: SWA window read (40 layers, 128 rows x 528 B, head dies) -- ONLY IF HBM-resident
paths.placement: UNSPECIFIED in W19 (replicated window; attend priced on-chip)
paths.limiter: 17 sectors a PC per layer: fixed latency dominates
paths.plan: keep the window on-chip (2.70 MB/die/user SMEM) or stream all 40 layers once a token into SMEM (660 sectors a PC, scan-like: 100% steady); decide placement in the HBM-accel model

paths.path: KV write-back (window row every layer on every die; CKV row + index key on the owner die at group close)
paths.gap: ot_hbm_accel_kv_lifecycle keys position[12:0] (Qwen 8K); no 1M-addressable DS write path RTL exists; stream PC is read-only
paths.ge_90pct: NOT MEASURED (bytes <0.5% of reads; must be non-blocking behind reads)

composition.note: W19 compose prices index_scores at the ROM scorer rate (10.6 TB/s a die for L20, 2.6x the 4-stack peak) and kv_gather as transport only (no HBM first access)
composition.verdict: MANDATORY (owner >=90% rule): refactor reaches 100% steady on the scans; gain on the token 0.86% (worst) because the paths are short

inconsistency: ladder_model R4b assumes a die scorer at NK 4 keys/cycle (7% of HBM peak, 2.86 us per L20 scan) while the W19 compose prices the scan above HBM peak; the composed DS HBM token needs one consistent scorer width (>=49 keys/cycle/die to be HBM-bound)
